items.title: Warm sonic logo
items.style: Warm young Hebrew brand voice; sing the two syllables in a gentle ascending major-third interval, 1.5 seconds. Clear human tone, no extra words.

items.title: Friendly smile
items.style: An audible bright smile, speak-sing two short notes, light upward lift on the second syllable, close cleanly.

items.title: Deep confident
items.style: Deep resonant male radio-ident timbre. Two measured musical pitches, firm and premium, no announcer lead-in.

items.title: Playful cartoon
items.style: Playful animated character voice, high buoyant rising two-note sing-song, playful crisp cut.

items.title: Elegant feminine
items.style: Elegant delicate female studio jingle, graceful legato rise then soft release, intimate dry vocal.

items.title: Opera soprano
items.style: Extreme operatic soprano coloratura: two syllables on distinct high notes with vibrato, absolutely no added words.

items.title: Opera basso
items.style: Extreme dramatic basso profundo, two pitched low notes, grand resonant operatic phonation.

items.title: Beatbox-like
items.style: Speak the name with percussive rhythmic articulation like a miniature beatbox hook; vocal sound only, no extra syllables.

items.title: Whisper melody
items.style: Almost-whispered breathy voice that still traces two musical pitches, intimate sonic signature.

items.title: Robot vocoder
items.style: Hyper-clean robotic synthetic vocoder timbre, two precisely quantized notes, futuristic yet understandable Hebrew.

items.title: Children cartoon
items.style: Cartoonishly tiny squeaky mascot voice with a wildly ascending pitch bend across the two syllables.

items.title: Retro radio
items.style: 1950s radio-jingle crooner, warm vinyl-like vocal coloration, two swung notes and tight ending, no speech before or after.

items.title: Pop hook
items.style: Catchy modern pop-vocal two-note hook, upbeat, energetic, perfect intonation, no instruments, only the name.

items.title: Jazz scat mimic
items.style: Jazz scat-style swung articulation but MUST sing exactly the Hebrew name, no scat filler or added phonemes.

items.title: R&B run
items.style: Soulful expressive R&B singer; first syllable grounded, second syllable glides with a short tasteful melisma.

items.title: Epic trailer
items.style: Epic cinematic trailer voice with two dramatic down-up pitches, massive vocal projection and brief reverb tail.

items.title: Glitch pop
items.style: Experimental glitch-pop chopped vocal cadence, two syllables in a syncopated stutter-like effect without repetition or extra sounds.
